Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up and for attaching your invoice. We've run a targeted export for BrightCart for 2026-12-12T00:00:00Z through 2026-12-19T00:00:00Z. Summary first:

- Total tokens charged in window: 3,842,172 (billing system)
- Expected/normal baseline (Nov): ~1,020,000 tokens
- Primary route contributing to spike: /v1/embed/stream (72% of excess)
- Top 3 API keys seen: bc_prod_01 (prod), bc_test_04 (staging), bc_importer_2026 (batch-import)

Initial observation: we see repeated requests attributed to bc_test_04 and bc_importer_2026 between 2026-12-12 02:00 and 2026-12-13 05:00 PST. The requests from bc_importer_2026 were unusually long (avg seq length 5.8x normal) — looks like an import job that iterated over large documents and hit the streaming route.

Attachments included: brightcart_usage_export_2026-12-19.csv (per-request rows: request_id, timestamp, route, model, token_count, api_key_tag, region), and redwood-usage-debug-log-20261219.txt (server-side prefix/tagging notes).

Next steps we recommend:
1) If bc_importer_2026 is an internal import you didn't intend to run, please confirm and provide any internal run IDs.
2) We can propose a one-time goodwill credit for the excess attributable to bc_importer_2026 and bc_test_04 if you confirm these were non-production.
3) Finance can place the Dec invoice on hold pending your confirmation — Jonas, can you confirm internal process for a provisional credit?
